description: This file defines the UniqueKey class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a unique identifier used in Orleans distributed actor framework. It includes methods for creating, parsing, comparing, and serializing unique keys based on various categories and GUIDs

classes.name: UniqueKey
classes.description: A sealed class representing a unique identifier for Orleans grains or system entities, supporting serialization, comparison, and parsing functionalities.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string or ReadOnlySpan<char> to create a UniqueKey instance, supporting hex string and GUID format.

methods.name: NewKey
methods.description: Static factory methods to create new UniqueKey instances, including GUID-based, long-based, or with specific categories and type data.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyToLong
methods.description: Converts the primary key to a long value, optionally with an extended key string.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyToGuid
methods.description: Converts the primary key to a GUID, optionally with an extended key string.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string representation of the UniqueKey instance.
